title: Tech Recruiter in a product-based company
description:
**Tech Recruiter In a Product\-based Company** 




  





**Company: Crossing Hurdles** 




  





 Employment Type: Full\-time
 



 Demographics (Super Important)
 


* Location: Sector 48, Gurgaon, Haryana, India
* Work Model: Hybrid (6 Days/week) with 5 Hrs in\-office \& 4 Hrs WFH
* In\-office \+ Partial WFH Shift (Everyday) \[60:40 split]



  





**About The Role** 




**If you have primary experience in closing roles for product\-based companies, this is for YOU.** 




 As a Recruitment Associate, you will own end\-to\-end hiring for US\-based roles, primarily for product\-driven startups. The role demands strong execution, stakeholder management, and the ability to deliver high\-quality candidates in a fast\-paced environment consistently.
 



**Experience (non\-negotiables)** 



* Minimum Experience: 2 to 8 years
* 1\+ years of experience in a PRODUCT\-BASED Company/RPO catering to product\-based companies \& startups. (necessary)
* Comfortable in interacting/interviewing with US\-based candidates.
* Comfortable operating in fast\-moving, ambiguous environments with minimal hand\-holding
* Excellent communicator who builds trust with candidates and hiring managers alike
* Highly organized, proactive, and motivated by building world\-class teams.



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Candidate Sourcing: Source high\-quality candidates from US\-specific job portals such as Dice, LinkedIn, Juicebox, and India\-based platforms like Naukri
* Screening \& Evaluation: Conduct in\-depth resume screening and initial interviews to identify top\-tier talent
* Client Management: Work closely with clients to understand hiring needs and translate them into effective sourcing strategies
* ATS Management: Utilize ATS tools to streamline recruitment processes, track pipelines, and maintain candidate data
* Market Research: Stay updated on industry trends, talent availability, and competitor hiring strategies
* Offer Management: Negotiate offers and manage candidate expectations through closure
* Collaboration: Work closely with internal teams to ensure successful hiring outcomes
* Team Leadership: Mentor junior recruiters and manage a team of 3\-5 members
